arts.ttl: Middlesbrough vs Coventry, EFL Championship Preview, Gameweek 17, 2025
arts.sum: A top-of-the-table clash awaits at the Riverside Stadium on Tuesday night as second-placed Middlesbrough welcome league-leaders Coventry City in what could prove a defining moment in the Championship promotion race. Coventry defeated Boro 2–0 late last season, with Jack Rudoni scoring both goals in a fixture that significantly impacted the play-off race.
There is a full round of Championship matches taking place across Tuesday and Wednesday and Tom Hill has a correct score prediction for all 12 games.

arts.ttl: Middlesbrough vs Coventry City predictions: Sky Blues to soar clear
arts.sum: Championship leaders Coventry City travel to face second-placed Middlesbrough at the Riverside and Enda McElhinney fancies the Sky Blues to take care of their goal-shy hosts on Teesside.
